newsitem.title: USA: Dow sinks to session lows, NYSE curbs back on.
newsitem.headline: Dow sinks to session lows, NYSE curbs back on.

text.p: The Dow Jones Industrial Average moved sharply lower in late trading, falling fast to a deficit of 80 points to 7607 and prompting the New York Stock Exchange to put curbs on program trading at 1502 EDT/1902 GMT.
The curbs were put on the when the blue-chip average fell about fifty points but it quickly sunk lower, the victim of "PT squared" -- profit-taking and program trading, according to one analyst.
The Nasdaq was also sharply lower, down nearly 11 to 1436. The bond market was also at session lows, down 17/32 to yield 6.78 percent.
